Name: AutomaticRun
Author: mioushou
Description:
[size=4][b][u]Description[/u][/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]A mod that lets you toggle auto-run so your farmer keeps moving in any direction without holding a key[/color]

[size=4][b][u]Installation instructions[/u][/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]   - Download and install the latest version of SMAPI
   - Download the latest release of AutomaticRun from:
   - Extract the contents of the downloaded archive into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder
   - Install Generic Mod Config Menu if you want in-game configuration options
   - Launch the game using SMAPI[/color]

[size=4][b][u]Main features[/u][/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]    - Toggle auto-run with a configurable key (default: Left Control / Left Stick on controllers)
    - Collision detection: optionally stop automatically when hitting a wall or obstacle
    - Controller support: works with both keyboard and controller inputs
    - Config menu: requires Generic Mod Config Menu[/color]

[size=4][b][u]Requirements[/u][/b][/size]
    - SMAPI
[i]Optional:[/i]
[i]    - Generic Mod Config Menu -> for in-game configuration options[/i]

[size=4][b][u]How to use[/u][/b][/size]
    - Press the configured toggle key (default: `Left Control` / `Left Stick`) to enable or disable auto-run
    - When enabled, your farmer will keep moving in the last direction you were walking without needing to hold the movement key
    - Works while riding as well
    - If collision detection is enabled, auto-run will stop when you hit a wall or obstacle
    - You can customize the toggle key and collision behavior in the mod config menu (if you have Generic Mod Config Menu installed) or by editing the `config.json` file directly in `.../Mods/AutomaticRun/config.json`
   - AutomaticRun works independently of Stardew Valley's auto run option. If that option is disabled, your farmer will run while the mod is active and return to walking when the mod is disabled.

[u][i]config.json example[/i][/u]:

{
  "ToggleKey": "LeftControl, LeftStick",
  "StopOnCollision": false
}

    - ToggleKey: the key (or key combination) used to toggle auto-run. Separate multiple keys with a comma (e.g. `"LeftControl, LeftStick"` means either key works)
    - StopOnCollision: set to `true` to automatically stop auto-run when hitting a wall or obstacle, `false` to keep running


[b]First mod ever so let me know if you run into any issues![/b]
Source code : [url=https://github.com/mioushou/AutomaticRun]Github[/url]
